verdict.rationale: Zero's README says the product does not track, collect, or sell user data, so there would be no telemetry to opt out of. This rests on a single first-party claim, and the pack documents no opt-out toggle or telemetry settings to confirm it. missing for 10: documented telemetry or analytics settings, an explicit opt-out mechanism or confirmation that no analytics SDKs are bundled, independent or hands-on verification of the no-tracking claim.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can opt out of telemetry and usage tracking

citations.quote: Zero does not track, collect, or sell your data in any way.
